Time for the only weapon left in my arsenal—pure psychological warfare. I need to rep EVERYTHING he might fear: trips, quads, the elusive ace-full boat, whatever. If I check, I’m dead. If I bet, I might as well be firing with a water-pistol, but sometimes the illusion of a bazooka is all it takes.

Leveraging my 840-chip stack, blasting exactly 80 keeps me credible: it’s 2/3 of the pot—a sizing that screams “You want this? Let the bluff-fest begin!

[Bet 80]
